summary: [standards] The fix is minimal and correct for the case it names (verified: the scenario's red record at b676851dd is divergent, green after; the ingest_removal_16 test compares literal subject lists before and after the delete and in a shallow clone; tombstones are dropped by without_removed in context.rs so latest_scenario is None for them). Guard edge: of_an_undeclared_scenario returns false when ctx.scenarios is empty, so a repo that deletes its LAST scenario keeps that scenario's old evidence judged stale-evidence. Probed on the real binary: one scenario, evidence, four commits (max_commits_behind 2), feature file deleted and inventory sync run: gate check still lists stale-evidence only.leaf.01. The empty-corpus guard exists to avoid judging every cell when the scenario kind is routed off the git tier or the index is unbuilt; the two cases are not told apart. Rare, no test pins it either way, and it does not affect this repo; worth a line in the staleness.rs module doc or a distinguishing check. Blast radius: the filter sits in fold_latest_green_cells, so it also removes a scenario cell with an undeclared id (a typo'd evidence --scenario) from staleness; coverage checks elsewhere still name it.
